agent_notes: All three supplied NIRF 2025 listings contain LNCT University in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. Normal TLS verification produced the managed proxy self-signed-certificate-in-chain error; public GETs then used curl --insecure for the expected NIRF and lnctu.ac.in hosts.
The official About and Contact pages identify the Kolar/J K Town campus in Bhopal district, Madhya Pradesh. Other campus references on the contact page were not used for this record.

The central official Courses Offered page contains 214 catalogue rows representing 195 unique exact programme names after removing only identical repeated LN/JK paramedical rows; it includes degree, diploma, certificate, doctoral and fellowship entries with explicit duration and eligibility text.
The official JK Paramedical page states that JK Paramedical College is a School of Paramedical Sciences in LNCT University; its unique catalogue programmes were retained.

Career mappings were checked against assets/data/career_path.db read-only. The career tree’s node 20 breadcrumb is copied verbatim as “Biology / PCB > Medical Updated”; this is a career-tree label issue, not an institution-site claim.
Search-engine results were used only to discover the official domain; official pages and NIRF listings are the verification evidence.
